title: Withdraw consent
purpose: Record that the participant withdrew consent, and stop use of their material where the withdrawal asks for it.
summary: Record that the participant withdrew consent, and stop use of their material where the withdrawal asks for it. Admin and manager only.

tasks.title: Record the withdrawal
steps: Enter [[Effective on]], [[Received at]], [[Received via]] and the [[Reason]].
Check the specimens and shipments listed, then select [[Withdraw consent]].

tasks.title: Follow up distributed material
steps: Afterwards, record what was done for each shipment from the consent page.

good_to_know: No further use holds the participant's specimens and releases allocations not yet picked, in one step.
No further contact only flags Do not contact.
Nothing is disposed, deleted or anonymized. A withdrawal is undone only by reinstating.

items.label: No further contact
items.description: Flags the consent Do not contact. Status, holds and allocations are unchanged.

items.label: No further use
items.description: In one step: the status becomes Withdrawn; every available or exhausted specimen of the participant in every collection the study governs or has governed gets a use hold (reference 'Consent withdrawn: participant, study'); allocations not yet picked are released; distributed specimens are counted for follow-up. Picked specimens stay picked: the hold blocks packing and dispatch and staff put them back.

items.label: No further use and destroy
items.description: As No further use, and the consent page then offers Request disposal of held specimens.

items.label: What was withdrawn
items.description: Required. While the consent is already withdrawn only No further contact is offered here. If a No further use withdrawal is in effect and the participant later requests destruction, use Escalate to destruction on the consent page.

items.label: Received at
items.description: Required; when the withdrawal reached the repository, not in the future.

items.label: Received via
items.description: Required, e.g. letter or phone call. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required; kept in the history and on the holds. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

sections.title: Rules
paragraphs: Only admin and manager can open or submit this form; other roles are refused. The server repeats every check when you save.
The form opens in a dialog over the page you came from; opened directly it is a full page. Cancel returns to that page without saving.

The form shows the participant's specimens in custody, open allocations and distributed items before you confirm. Nothing is disposed, deleted or anonymized; a withdrawal is undone only by Reinstate consent by another manager. If someone else changed the record since you opened the form, the save is refused with a message to reload; the form keeps your entries and the next save uses the current version, so check the current values first.
